text:
priya: Heads-up — onboarding novaX-12k into the eval harness. Quick local runs show weird token alignment in the chat evals, EM and ROUGE jump ~12% on some prompts. not confident it's real.

sam: any deterministic repro? random seed, template?

priya: yes small repro. batch=8, seq=4096, chat template with system + 2 turns. flaky only when collate does padding from the tokenizer. suspect pad/token-id mismatch.

lee: saw this pattern before — if pad_id used by collate != tokenizer.pad_token_id, the KV offsets shift and generation reads wrong positions. leads to truncation or shifted responses.

maria: can you paste the collate snippet and tokenizer config?

priya: sure — here's the relevant bits from our runner:
```python
def collate_batch(examples, pad_id=0):
    # naive pad to 0
    maxlen = max(len(x) for x in examples)
    out = np.full((len(examples), maxlen), pad_id, dtype=np.int32)
    return out
```
and tokenizer.config: {"pad_token_id": 1, "bos_token_id": 0, "eos_token_id": 2} (novaX checkpoint).

sam: aha. collate defaulting to 0 but tokenizer pad is 1. That will cause every example to have a different effective offset when sent to the model.

priya: confirmed — when I change pad_id to tokenizer.pad_token_id the EM / Rouge revert to expected.

lee: we need a CI guard: assert runner.collate.pad_id == tokenizer.pad_token_id at harness startup and a small unit test that recreates the mismatch case. also add a lint rule to avoid hardcoded pad ids.

maria: +1. add a dashboard regression alert too — this kind of latent mismatch can sneak into production metrics. tag:perf/regression.

sam: I'll open a quick PR:
- add assert in eval_runner/__init__.py
- add unit test test_samplepad_alignment in tests/runner/test_pad_behavior.py that param fuzzes pad ids and verifies model outputs stable only when matched
- update collate docs mentioning tokenizer.pad_token_id usage

priya: thanks. also note tokenizer special tokens vary: some checkpoints use pad=1, others use pad=0. we should not assume pad==0 anywhere in the harness.

ci-bot: PR #4123 opened by sam: "fix: enforce tokenizer.pad_token_id in collate + tests" — CI triggered.

eval-runner-bot: queued job 98765 for flaky-repro with seed 42, batch=8, seq=4096.

ci-bot: test run: unit 146/148 passed, failing: tests/runner/test_pad_behavior.py::test_mismatch_detects (expected).

sam: fixing test assertion (we expected fail for mismatch) and adding a recovery path: if mismatch detected, log error + fail early.

maria: once merged, can we backfill a one-off eval job for recent model onboarding runs? attach eval ids so we can tag regressions and rollback if needed.

priya: yes — I'll queue a re-eval for the last 7 onboarding checkpoints and post a short report.

lee: follow-up idea: add a CI lint that scans model config uploads for pad/bos/eos presence and warns on missing tokens. prevents half-broken checkpoints getting into the harness.

priya: agreed. thanks y'all. saved a bunch of noisy false-positive metric alerts. :relieved:

ci-bot: PR #4123 merged into main. Deploying new eval-runner image.

eval-runner-bot: rerun complete for queued job 98765 — outputs stable, metrics back to baseline.

maria: awesome — please add a short blurb to the onboarding checklist ("verify tokenizer.pad_token_id matches collate/prefix settings") and I'll add the dashboard alert rule.

sam: done — checklist updated in docs and added a small example snippet showing how to pull pad id from HF tokenizer: `tokenizer.pad_token_id or tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids("[PAD]")`.

priya: closing this thread. will paste the re-eval summaries when ready.
